in_marathi.name: Kshyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Cosmos
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kshyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Kshyati', which means 'to rule' or 'to reign'. This name signifies one who rules or governs the cosmos, implying immense power and control over the universe. In Hindu mythology, Kshyansh is also the name of a powerful deity who is believed to protect and nurture the universe.
